mapping.draft_py:
# FDN Garna, Bloodfist of Keld: "Whenever another creature you control dies, draw a card if it was
# attacking. Otherwise, Garna deals 1 damage to each opponent."
# One triggered ability, as printed (M5 mapper's draft_conditional, written after engine wave E1).
# Event: "another creature you control dies" (CreatureDiesEvent: CONTROLLER_IS YOU, a creature,
# FNot(IS_SOURCE)). Effect: an effect-level branch, judged as the ability resolves (CR 608.2c),
# on "it", the creature that died, by its last known information (CR 603.10a, 608.2h): E1 made
# IS_ATTACKING read LastKnown.attacking and a bare Conditional judge it on the event's object.
# "draw a card" (then) / "Garna deals 1 damage to each opponent" (else: DEAL_DAMAGE over every
# opponent player, Zone(PLAYER, OPPONENT)).
# Not the two-trigger draft (draft_split.py, IS_ATTACKING / FNot(IS_ATTACKING) in two event
# filters): the text has one ability whose "if" is no intervening "if" (it does not follow the
# trigger condition, CR 603.4) but an instruction with an "Otherwise", so the branch belongs in
# the effect; the split makes two abilities from one (an ability that counts or counters
# triggers sees two) and a second encoding of an effect branch (MAPPER_GUIDE: only an intervening
# "if" is a condition, and an event filter holds what qualifies the trigger itself).
trigger = TriggeredAbility(
    event=CreatureDiesEvent(
        filter=FAnd(
            children=(
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                FNot(inner=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE)),
            ),
        ),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=Conditional(
        pred=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_ATTACKING),
        then_effect=A(Verb.DRAW, {'amount': QConst(value=1), 'controller': ControllerRef.YOU}),
        else_effect=A(Verb.DEAL_DAMAGE, {
            'amount': QConst(value=1),
            'target': Selector(
                count=QUnbounded(),
                mode=SelectorMode.ALL,
                filter=FAnd(children=()),
                zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.PLAYER, controller=ControllerRef.OPPONENT),),
            ),
        }),
    ),
)
abilities = [trigger, *compiled]

clauses.clause: Whenever another creature you control dies, draw a card if it was attacking.
clauses.ir: abilities[0] (CreatureDiesEvent; Conditional IS_ATTACKING on the dead creature -> DRAW 1)

clauses.clause: Otherwise, Garna deals 1 damage to each opponent.
clauses.ir: abilities[0] (the Conditional's else: DEAL_DAMAGE 1 to every opponent)
